verdict.rationale: Neon documents native pgvector extension support (neon-docs-15/32) which allows storing embeddings and running vector similarity search directly in Postgres without a separate vector DB, and this is corroborated as a dedicated first-party doc page rather than a passing mention. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of pgvector usage specifically (e.g. benchmarks or real-world embeddings workloads on Neon) and details on index types (HNSW/IVFFlat) or performance at scale.
